title: Iovec aggregate limits and edge cases need contract checks
mechanism: copy_iovs_and_convert truncates the aggregate iovec length at isize::MAX instead of Linux MAX_RW_COUNT, IoVec::is_empty treated a NULL base with nonzero length as empty at the pin, and overlapping or aliased iovecs reach untyped OSTD copies with no defined overlap result.
contract: Vectored I/O transfers at most MAX_RW_COUNT bytes, faults on a NULL base with nonzero length, and handles iovecs in array order (readv(2), Linux lib/iov_iter.c).
observed: Source only: the aggregate is capped at isize::MAX and, at the pin, a NULL-base nonzero-length entry is skipped as empty. No contract violation has been demonstrated.

repro.how_to_run: No reproducer. finding.md Reproduction describes a 4 GiB aliased writev/readv against /dev/null and /dev/zero, a NULL-base writev, and overlapping-iovec checks.

caveats: No confirmed bug. The isize::MAX aggregate bound is a documented design choice. The NULL-base sub-case was changed by PR #3720 (merged 2026-08-27 per the dedup inventory, not listed by the dedup for AST-37) and must be retested on the target revision.
